top_signals.title: Tech Rally Fizzles as Rising Oil Flags Macro Risks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rally in technology stocks came to a halt as oil resumed its role in setting the tone for markets, with Brent heading for its first gain in a week as investors tracked diplomatic efforts to end the US-Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
